Downtown.name: Downtown
Downtown.description: Court Street hill to Main Street commercial core with the city's densest renovation pipeline: upper-floor apartment conversions, facade grants, and institutional anchors.

Riverfront.name: Riverfront
Riverfront.description: James River arts-and-amphitheater district below Ninth Street where mill-warehouse stock converts to dining, lofts, and riverwalk-adjacent hospitality.

Diamond Hill.name: Diamond Hill
Diamond Hill.description: Historic brick rowhouse district on the hill southwest of downtown with investor-led restoration and first-time-buyer turnover.

Tinbridge Hill.name: Tinbridge Hill
Tinbridge Hill.description: Working residential grid between Federal Street and the Miller Park edge with steady repair-trade permitting and infill interest.

Heritage.name: Heritage
Heritage.description: Wards Road corridor neighborhoods around the Heritage schools and the airport commercial strip, absorbing medical-office and retail refit demand.

Boonsboro.name: Boonsboro
Boonsboro.description: Affluent Boonsboro Road corridor of estate infill, Peaks View-adjacent subdivisions, and the Link Road retail node.

Wyndhurst.name: Wyndhurst
Wyndhurst.description: Master-planned new-urbanist district off Lakeside Drive mixing tract build-out, the Wyndhurst Industrial Corridor's flex space, and Liberty University spillover.
